tytul: Dried salted fish (vobla, taran): why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for dried salted fish such as vobla or taran, which is traditionally salted and dried whole, without gutting. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to the FDA, gut any fish before salting, drying, pickling or fermenting it. [T:MIE-061]
The FDA considers uneviscerated (ungutted) fish that are salt-cured, dried or smoked a potentially life-threatening health hazard. [T:MIE-067]
According to the FDA, these products are hazardous whether they are stored at room temperature, in the refrigerator or in the freezer. [T:MIE-070]

akapity: The FDA reports that kapchunka, an ungutted salted and dried fish, caused botulism outbreaks with deaths in the USA. [T:MIE-068]
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for dried salted fish, gutted or ungutted from a checked source. [T:-]
